name: Sem
description: Local structural code search, caller navigation, impact analysis and entity-level diffs. Requires a source checkout accessible to the server process. Validation tools can execute repository commands; repository selection is not a sandbox.

SEM_REPO.description: Absolute path to the trusted source checkout on the machine running the server.

SEM_NO_NETWORK.description: Set to 1 to disable Sem network features for local-only use.
